_comment: Copy to config.json (chmod 600) and fill in. This file is the ONLY place secrets live. Pass it with --config <path> or ALIRAN_MCP_CONFIG. Give panel/broadcaster an explicit https `url` (a Caddy TLS endpoint) OR omit `url` and the loopback API (:3210 / :3310) is reached over an SSH local-forward tunnel opened with the ssh key below. `user`/`pass` for panel & broadcaster are their DASHBOARD admin logins (created by `add-admin`, or by `server_install`).
